claims.where: controls[0]: governs; summary; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Planner Agent chat access control covers access to the chat in which saved filters are planned.
claims.quote:
To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The same AllowPlannerCopilot setting governs Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat together.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true

claims.claim: The Planner Agent access setting has organization-wide scope.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can control access to these features for your organization or restrict them to specific security groups.

claims.claim: Planner Agent and chat access can be restricted to a specific security group.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: Changes to the Planner Agent access policy can take up to an hour to become effective.
